items.name: Ohio State Duos I 2024

organisers.name: [{Braden Richards}{mailto:brichards@worldcubeassociation.org}] [{Keenan Darkins}{mailto:darkins.kb@gmail.com}] [{The Rubik's Cube Club at Ohio State}{mailto:ohiostatecubeclub@gmail.com}]

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBclZpIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a4b848f0c3a0a951d41e58dab8b21e6a95832579/0.png) This competition takes place on a **Friday** evening and will only feature 3x3x3 Fewest Moves and Clock. This competition is not recommended for first-timers or for those looking for a typical competition experience. Please consider instead any of the [many other competitions happening in Ohio.](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list) Only one guest per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest as spectator seating will be limited. All attendees under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a chaperone any time they are not in the competition room per Ohio Union policy, regardless of whether they are a competitor or guest.
